p-collector.label: Ellipsoidal Mo/Si collector
p-collector.geometry: Ellipsoid with plasma at F1, IF at F2; rim from sourced 5.5 sr, foci spacing from patent range.
p-collector.physics: collects Ω/2π of in-band EUV; reflects R = 41 %

p-vessel.label: Source vessel
p-vessel.geometry: Conical vacuum envelope collector→IF; size not found in any source.
p-vessel.physics: holds ~100 Pa H2 buffer gas (S001 slide 39)

p-vessel-rear.label: Rear flange, laser port
p-vessel-rear.geometry: Flange with central port for the drive beam.

p-intermediate-focus.label: Intermediate focus aperture
p-intermediate-focus.geometry: Aperture ring at F2, the source–scanner interface.
p-intermediate-focus.physics: EUV power delivered here (≤ upper bound)

p-final-focus-optics.label: Drive-laser final focus
p-final-focus-optics.geometry: Housing behind collector; beam enters through central aperture (S004 §4).

p-droplet-generator.label: Tin droplet generator
p-droplet-generator.geometry: Nozzle tube + body across the focus; positions inferred.
p-droplet-generator.physics: 27 µm droplets, 80 m/s, 50 kHz → 1.6 mm pitch

p-droplet-catcher.label: Tin catcher
p-droplet-catcher.geometry: Tube opposite the nozzle; dimensions inferred.
p-droplet-catcher.physics: collects unused tin ≈ 13 g/h total flow

p-obscuration.label: On-axis obscuration
p-obscuration.geometry: Disk + strut on axis; existence from S005, place/size inferred.
p-obscuration.physics: blocks direct laser light toward IF
